originality.rationale: Gečiauskas 1966 and 1968 derive general distribution integral formulas, not explicit seventh-order curvature-gradient energies in the inspected texts. Rataj 2004 Theorem 3 establishes third-order directional covariogram derivatives, hence covers the fifth-order distance coefficient but not the computed fifth directional derivative or the seventh-order distance term. Inspected full texts/sections of Rataj, Meyer–Reisner–Schmuckenschläger and Bianchi do not supply the specific integrated curvature-gradient expression or explicit sign-changing analytic family. Published polygonal short-pair results do not imply the smooth-curvature asymptotic. Remaining historical priority uncertainty is recorded.
